description: Published MIT / Hsu 2013 aggregate guide specificity score (crispr.mit.edu 'Guide score', CRISPOR calcMitGuideScore): 100/(100 + sum of per-hit scores) * 100, with per-hit scores from the Hsu model, or from the Tycko 2018 SaCas9 model for SaCas9 PAMs as the reference does.

guide_sequence.description: Guide RNA sequence (length must match the system's guide length).

max_mismatches.description: Maximum allowed mismatches (range 0..5; default 4, the reference's default).

errors.message: Guide sequence cannot be null or empty
